title: Review CloudTrail Logs for Activity
description: Inspect CloudTrail logs for any additional activity related to the stopped logging operation to confirm if the key was ever active.
recommended_next_focus: Confirm if the key was ever active and review any unusual behaviors.

title: Investigate User Activities Associated with Access Key
description: Explore the user activities associated with the access key to see if there were any unusual behaviors during its lifecycle.
recommended_next_focus: Assess the overall security posture of the affected resources.

title: Verify Last Known Active Use of Access Key
description: Examine the last known active use of the access key to determine if it was ever active and if there were any unusual behaviors during its lifecycle.
recommended_next_focus: Identify the last known active use of the access key and any associated user activities.
